transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got our final-lock meeting today for Night Signal's public opening this Friday. As you all know, we're looking at the draft plan that assumes a max of 96 visitors at once, two-way circulation, no reserved control tablets, and four floor attendants. Let's go through our standard operating reports — technical, accessibility, and labor leads, in that order — and then I'll make my final call on whether we approve the package. Who'd like to start?

transcript.text: Before we get into the standard reports, I need to flag something critical from this morning. I completed the fire-marshal egress walkthrough today, and the result changes our operating parameters significantly. The installation may admit at most 72 visitors at once — not 96 — and visitors must be routed one-way clockwise through the east exit, not two-way circulation. I have not yet entered the signed walkthrough result in the production lock memo, but I'm disclosing it now so we can revise the package accordingly before approval.
